title: A hermeneutical study of "śamatha and vipaśyanā focused on the combined teachings" in the Saṃdhinirmocanasūtra
core_idea: To fill a gap in contemporary scholarship by providing a hermeneutical, textual, and philosophical analysis of the Saṃdhinirmocanasūtra's presentation of 'śamatha and vipaśyanā focused on the combined teachings,' examining its conceptual relation to Mahāyāna religious practice and the theory of suchness, and articulating its practice components (initial application of attention, sustained attention, resolution).
tldr: Hermeneutical/textual study investigating how a combined-teachings form of śamatha and vipaśyanā in the Saṃdhinirmocanasūtra relates to Mahāyāna practice and the doctrine of suchness, and explicates its proposed practice elements.
